method: Offline replay through the production interpreter source via a C ABI test bridge. This is not instruction execution inside shadPS4.

clang.in_use_tracking: Provided by caller; replay uses the probe's captured clean/dirty states.

gcc.in_use_tracking: Provided by caller; replay uses the probe's captured clean/dirty states.

build: Linux Clang 19 Release; full emulator build passed
notes: All 224 physical capture rows replayed, including static and generated source rows; their mode labels do not mean the generated-code runtime is integrated.
Save-image comparisons are exact for 160 recorded memory images. Register comparisons exclude empty x87 values, pointer metadata and reserved fields.

Save inputs come from captured unchanged register images; restore inputs and malformed buffers reproduce main.cpp. In-use masks are supplied from the probe clean/dirty setup, not tracked by a running backend.
remaining_integration: guest architectural state capture, in-use tracking and host-state restoration
guest exception delivery at the original instruction
native handling of guest MXCSR.MM on hosts that lack it
